findings.title: traceID no longer included in plugin request log
findings.body: The explicit `traceID` log param was removed. The replacement, `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)`, adds only contextual attributes such as endpoint, pluginId and dsName. Whether it also adds traceID depends on the infra logger's context providers, and the plugin log wrapper's FromContext falls back to `d.New()` when the type assertion fails, which drops all context. In that fallback case, "Plugin Request Completed" logs lose the traceID and all plugin and request details.

findings.title: Adding a method to the exported Logger interface breaks other implementations
findings.body: `FromContext` is added to the public `plugins/log.Logger` interface. Any other implementations, such as fakes in other packages, test loggers or enterprise code, will stop compiling until they implement the new method.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger, so logged calls cannot be asserted
findings.body: `FromContext` returns `NewTestLogger()`, a new instance, instead of `f`. Since LoggerMiddleware now always logs through `FromContext(ctx)`, tests that use TestLogger will never see the recorded Info calls. Returning `f` would keep those calls observable.
